8.name: Break Dancin' 2: Electric Rugaloo
8.overview: The Bracket One Queens are first to enter the Untucked Lounge in this season’s Tournament of All Stars. The competition is intensifying, and no one knows who they can trust. The Queens and Bruno have a birthday surprise for guest judge La Toya Jackson.

8.name: Bar Queen Couture
8.overview: One Queen wrestles with her placement in the competition. Another Queen is called out for her messy strategy. Guest judge Kate Hudson gets the tea on the Bracket One drama.

8.name: Shop Til U Drop
8.overview: The Bracket One queens make their final pleas for MVQ points. A heartwarming gesture comes from an unexpected source.

8.name: Duets: It Takes Two
8.overview: The Bracket 2 queens are coming in HOT! The girls waste no time getting strategic as they scramble to gain points. Plus, guest judge Renée Rapp shows off a few tricks of her own.

8.name: How-To Videos
8.overview: The animals are loose in the Untucked Lounge! The queens let their hair down — and their hooves out — in their Barn This Way runway looks. But things get messy when the race for MVQ points leaves one queen questioning her alliance.

8.name: Too Many Daddies
8.overview: Bracket 2 comes to an EXPLOSIVE conclusion as the queens claw their way to the semi-finals. The night is full of surprises, nothing goes as planned, and not everyone makes it out in one piece.

8.name: Athletic Supporter Design Challenge
8.overview: The Bracket 3 queens enter the Untucked Lounge ready to play the game. But with alliances up in the air, no one is quite sure whose team they want to join. Guest judge Juno Temple brings her boundless energy for a kiki with the girls.

8.name: Rappin' Roast Redux
8.overview: After an emotional day, one queen feels underestimated, while another struggles to keep her good nature from getting in the way of strategy. The ladies also fawn over guest judge Brian Tyree Henry.

8.name: That's What She Said
8.overview: The math is mathing as the Bracket 3 queens try to predict who will make it into the semi-finals. Despite their nerves, they make the most of one last time together in the lounge. In the end, the queens are shocked by the final results.

8.name: Tell Me Something Good
8.overview: The bottom Semi-Finalists Rate-A-Queen before retreating to the Untucked Lounge. As the queens wrestle with the fallout from their rankings, they brace for the aftermath.

8.name: Tournament of All Stars Talent Rumble
8.overview: Emotions run high after the Talent Show, and the fear of lip syncing sends the girls into a tailspin. Two queens are left out in the cold while the rest of the group savors their last Untucked before the Finals.

8.name: Disco Smackdown For The Crown
8.overview: The queens get set to boogie down in the Disco Smackdown for the Crown. As the finalists battle it out on the main stage, the eliminated queens gather in the Werk Room for a watch party to see who comes out on top!

originalTitle: RuPaul's Drag Race All Stars: UNTUCKED
overview: An access-all-areas pass to the drama that you didn't see on the runway. See what happens behind the scenes when the queens let their tucks breathe... and let their emotions flow.

seasons.name: Season 2
seasons.overview: This season of Untucked featured the queens' backstage deliberation, a segment with the Lip Sync Assassin, their votes for the next eliminated queen, and a little interview of Michelle Visage and the eliminated queen.
